name: LatchBio
description: The Latch MCP lets you connect Latch to Claude, allowing you to browse data, start bioinformatics workflows and monitor workflow executions. Run serverless bioinformatics pipelines written in Nextflow or Python without leaving Claude.

_published_faq.name: How do I add LatchBio to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add LatchBio to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.latch.bio/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the LatchBio MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: LatchBio provides these MCP tools: list_files, get_file, list_workflows, get_workflow_schema, launch_workflow, list_executions, get_execution, get_task_logs, and list_workspaces.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to LatchBio?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to LatchBio in life-sciences on the Manufact MCP catalog include AdisInsight, Boltz API, Helix GenoSphere, Inductive Bio, and Owkin.
LatchBio requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
LatchBio is developed by LatchBio. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
